name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-sf

tools.name: sf_recent
tools.description: Recent records from a common San Francisco open dataset (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime/police incidents in San Francisco", "SF 311 complaints", "SF building permits / evictions / business registrations", "SF restaurant inspection scores", "SFO passenger traffic", "SF purchasing / procurement / vendor spending / commodity codes". Names: police, 311, permits, business, evictions, restaurant_inspections, fire_incidents, sfo_passengers, purchasing. Returns the latest rows (sorted newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use sf_query.

dataset.description: One of: police, 311, permits, business, evictions, restaurant_inspections, fire_incidents, sfo_passengers, purchasing.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "incident_category='Larceny Theft'" or "supervisor_district=6". Omit for all recent rows.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: sf_query
tools.description: Run a raw SoQL query against any San Francisco open-data resource (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "wg3w-h783" or "ebsh-uavg"). Covers SF city purchasing/procurement records (resource id "ebsh-uavg") — real column names fiscal_year, po_dt, purchase_order, purchase_order_line, purchasing_department, purchasing_department_title, commodity_code, commodity_title (the item name/description column — there is no "commodity_description"), vendor_name, vendor_street, vendor_city, vendor_state, vendor_zip_code, vendor_contact, vendor_email, vendor_phone, encumbered_quantity, encumbered_amount — as well as every other SF Socrata dataset by resource id; if you do not already know a dataset's exact column names, omit `select` (every column comes back) rather than guessing one, since Socrata 400s on an unknown column instead of ignoring it. Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use sf_datasets to find a resource id, or sf_recent for the common ones (including "purchasing").

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: sf_datasets
tools.description: Search the San Francisco open-data catalogue (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) for datasets by keyword — covers categories like parking, housing, trees, and city purchasing/procurement/vendor spending. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with sf_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-sf forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-sf pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
